title: Finite evaluation of the identity-normalized refinement mate
statement: Fix finite-field data D, a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, system Operations o and Realizations z of [def-sf-integral-system-operations] and [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge], and m≥0. For a quasi-compact finite-field-space arrow f:X→Y, compactifications c,d and a refinement r:c→d, and arbitrary system M on X, take only the refinement proper/open factor: open_d of the inverse bridge-normalized identity direct image, followed by z.properOpen.gamma(c.i,1_X,r.hom,d.i). Its mth evaluation followed by the direct r.hom coordinate and the realized direct image of fixedShriek(c.i,M) equals shriek(d.i,M) followed by the realized finite inverse identity direct image and finite proper/open mate. Coordinates are those of [def-sf-system-finite-evaluation-coordinates]. The outer proper image to Y and its compositor are absent.

proof.text: The canonical intrinsic coefficient equivalence transports open extension by its fixed adjunction and direct image by its section/K-injective normalization. The identity case transports the inverse system identity to the finite inverse identity. Naturality and unit-counit cancellation give precisely the proper/open-factor square. No gamma is inverted and no faithfulness of derived evaluations is used.

theorem refinementMate (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (o : Operations l E)
    (z : Realizations l E D o) (m : ℕ)
    {X Y : Spaces D} {f : X ⟶ Y} [QuasiCompact f.hom.left]
    (c d : Compactification f.hom.left) (r : c.Refinement d)
    (M : System l E X.obj.left) :
    let A := ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (m + 1))
    let RW := sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence d.Z (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (m + 1))
    haveI := c.quasiCompact_openImmersion (inferInstance : QuasiCompact f.hom.left)
    haveI := d.quasiCompact_openImmersion (inferInstance : QuasiCompact f.hom.left)
    (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E d.Z m).map
        ((Operations.shriek l E o d.i).map
          ((z.canonicalBridge.push l E (𝟙 X.obj.left) ≪≫
            SemilinearProperOpen.sId (scalarRings l E) (scalarTransitions l E)
              X.obj.left).inv.app M) ≫
          (z.properOpen.gamma c.i (𝟙 X.obj.left) r.hom d.i
            (r.i_hom.trans (Category.id_comp _).symm)).app M) ≫
      (push l E o m r.hom ((Operations.shriek l E o c.i).obj M)).hom ≫
      RW.functor.map ((ProperOpenPush A r.hom).map (fixedShriek l E o m c.i M).hom) =
    (shriek l E o m d.i M).hom ≫
      RW.functor.map
        ((ProperOpenShriek A d.i).map
          (((ordinary D A).sId X).inv.app (input l E m X.obj.left M)) ≫
          (properOpenMate A c.i (𝟙 X.obj.left) r.hom d.i
            (r.i_hom.trans (Category.id_comp _).symm)).app
              (input l E m X.obj.left M))
